verdict.rationale: Drata serves an llms.txt on its help center (help.drata.com/llms.txt), which indexes help-center content such as the Champion's Guide and rollout toolkit, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, probes show the developer portal has no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no fetchable OpenAPI spec, so agent-oriented coverage of the API docs is not evidenced. Missing for 10: llms.txt or markdown on developers.drata.com, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence the llms.txt covers API/developer content, independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
